content: Standard dependency-free MongoDB distributed lock: a locks collection keyed by _id=lock_name, fields holder/acquired_at/expires_at, TTL index on expires_at (expireAfterSeconds=0) as a stale-lock safety net. Acquire via atomic find_one_and_update filtering on {_id, expires_at:{$lte: now}} with upsert=True; catch DuplicateKeyError to detect a live lock held by another process. Release via delete_one({_id, holder}) in a finally block so a run that outlived its TTL doesn't delete a newer holder's lock.
